sentences.text:
Respondents
 ---
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Anubha Rawat Choudhary
---

For the Petitioner : Mr. Anuj Kumar, Advocate For the Respondents : Mr. Aditya Raman, Advocate
04/16.06.2023
1. Learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the respondents are present.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the surviving defects in the present case has
already been removed yesterday.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that considering the urgency in the present case,
the matter may be taken up on merits.
4.  Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the matter relates to disbursement of amount under Land Acquisition Act and there is dispute regarding apportionment of share.

He has referred to paragraph no.6 of the writ petition to submit that earlier Title Suit was decided which was subject matter of consideration by the learned District Judge-I, Sahibganj in Civil Appeal No.13/1999 wherein after setting aside the final decree dated 18.11.1999 passed by the Sub- Ordinate Judge-I, Sahibganj in Title Suit No.15/52 / 23/55 and the matter has been remanded back for preparation of fresh Final Decree.
Learned counsel has further submitted that pursuant to the order of remand, final decree has not been prepared which is under process.

5. He has also submitted that against judgment passed by the Appellate Court, Second Appeal bearing S.A No.505 of 2017 was filed before this Court, which has been dismissed for default and the petitioner has filed restoration application being C.M.P. No. 232 of 2023, which is presently pending before this Court.

Learned counsel further submitted that the fact remains that the final decree has Md. Fakruddin vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158772045/
1 not yet been prepared.

entities.text: Md. Fakruddin vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. It is submitted that under the aforesaid circumstances, the Respondent Authority cannot disburse the amount, unless the apportionment of share with regards to the property is finally determined.

He has relied upon the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Telangana High Court reported in 2020 Supreme (Telangana) 623 to submit that the dispute regarding apportionment of the compensation is to be decided by Competent Court of civil jurisdiction.

The learned counsel submits that in view of the aforesaid circumstances that some interim relief be granted so that the compensation amount be not disbursed and notice be issued to the private respondent.

7. Learned counsel for the respondent-State is directed to seek instruction and file supplementary counter affidavit in the present case with regard to the submission, which has been advanced on behalf of the petitioner.

8. Issue notice to the private respondent Nos. 5 to 16 under Speed Post as well as registered Cover with A/D and for which, requisites etc., must be filed by Monday.
9. Post this case on 27th July, 2023 awaiting service report.
10.
Till the next date i.e. 27.07.2023, the compensation amount shall not be disbursed in favour of any party.

(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Raja/-
